description: KNaGdTaO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.27 Å. Gd is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Gd-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. Ta is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.85 Å) and four longer (1.95 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Ta atom to form distorted OK₄NaTa octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OK₄NaTa octahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaGd₂Ta tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent OK₄NaTa octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Gd, and one Ta atom to form distorted ONaGd₂Ta tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄NaTa octahedra, corners with ten equivalent ONaGd₂Ta tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent ONaGd₂Ta tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 71-72°.
